segments.text: "There’s no use in resisting. Become the Queen, and live here for the rest of your life."
A man of few words, he is one of the Queen’s advisors. He always puts his duty before anything else, and does not show much emotion, acting very cold to Airi too. Snow’s younger twin.
From Reibakkari
"Don’t worry. No one will really notice the small issues, after all."

One of the Queen’s advisors, and the older twin. He is friendly to all and has a soothing personality. Though he always has a warm smile on his face, when it comes to his job, he can sometimes forcefully make things go his way.
From Reibakkari
"Um, since the weather’s so nice today... Ah, no, that’s not what I meant to say — Um……"

The leader of the Royal Knights. He does his work seriously and is a kind person. He is a skilled swordsman, but always gets nervous around Luna and acts somewhat strangely as a result. Childhood friends with Minette, the Cheshire Cat.
From Reibakkari
"What cute face. Where did you come from? How old are you?"
A self-proclaimed magician. He has a pretty face, but he’s always wandering about, and no one can understand his intentions. Childhood friends with Jack, the leader of the Royal Knights.
From Reibakkari
"You seem bored… Shall I take you away from here?"

A young merchant who’s often seen in the castle. He loves anything that’s fun and interesting, and dislikes anything complicated or difficult. He’s good friends with the Mad Hatter, Kanon, whom he’s often seen together with.
From Reibakkari
"I’m tired today, so I’ll be leaving now. See you."

A young man who works as a hatter in town. He has a twisted personality that doesn’t match his appearance, and generally doesn’t care about other people. He’s good with his hands, and is particularly good at embroidery and sewing.
From Reibakkari
"This place feels somewhat familiar, even though I’ve never been here before."
Heroine of the White Route
Second year student at Aiyama High School. Surrounded by her family and friends, she lives a peaceful life.
From Reibakkari
"My only wish is to return to my own world. That’s all."
Heroine of the Black Route.
The current queen of the World of Black. She has a strong sense of responsibility, hates to losing, and takes pride in her position as the the Queen.
From Reibakkari
One of the classmate. Has bright personality, she's like an older sister to everyone.
One of the classmate. A person with relaxed personality. Good at fortune telling.
One of the classmate. Thinks everything is troublesome, but can't refuse if asked.
A boy with fluffy hair. Nello and Kanon's friend who is always seen with a sleepy face.
The caterpillar.
Leader of merchant guild. Has tall and a scar on his eye. He always seen with a cigarette.
The duchess.
Owner of Minnet. She likes beautiful thing, while she herself is beautiful. Has very gentle and comfortable personality.
The trump troops.
Jack's colleague who has bright and refreshing personality.
One of the stuffed animal twins. Likes to talks in riddle.
One of the stuffed animal twins. Likes to talks in riddle.
A college student who is a lecturer at a cram school in the White world.
Plays the part of an ordinary relaxed and sociable young man, but thinks a world where everything goes as one expects every day is boring.
Humpty Dumpty.
A mysterious person with the name of "Joker".
